verses.text: For the choir director. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah, set to Alamoth. A Song. God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
verses.textZh: （可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。）神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是我們在患難中隨時的幫助。

verses.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth should change And though the mountains slip into the heart of the sea;
verses.textZh: 所以，地雖改變，山雖搖動到海心，

verses.text: Though its waters roar [and] foam, Though the mountains quake at its swelling pride. Selah.
verses.textZh: 其中的水雖匉訇翻騰，山雖因海漲而戰抖，我們也不害怕。（細拉）

verses.text: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, The holy dwelling places of the Most High.
verses.textZh: 有一道河，這河的分使　神的城歡喜；這城就是至高者居住的聖所。

verses.text: God is in the midst of her, she will not be moved; God will help her when morning dawns.
verses.textZh: 神在其中，城必不動搖；到天一亮，神必幫助這城。

verses.text: The nations made an uproar, the kingdoms tottered; He raised His voice, the earth melted.
verses.textZh: 外邦喧嚷，列國動搖；神發聲，地便鎔化。

verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！（細拉）

verses.text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who has wrought desolations in the earth.
verses.textZh: 你們來看耶和華的作為，看他使地怎樣荒涼。

verses.text: He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariots with fire.
verses.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地極；他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。

verses.text: 'Cease [striving] and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
verses.textZh: 你們要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。

verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！
